title: Frame rate counter
description:
Measure frames per second and frame times from timestamps.

```
frames in the last second: 58
average 17.2 ms, worst 33.1 ms (one slow frame)
1% low: 30 fps
```
hints: `std::deque<T>` (from `<deque>`) is a sequence that is cheap to change at both ends, which makes it a natural queue: `push_back(x)` adds at the back, `front()` reads the oldest element, `pop_front()` removes it, and `empty()` says whether any are left.
Drop times older than `now - 1.0` from the front of the deque; what is left is the last second (lesson 10.02).
For the 1% low, sort the frame durations and look at the slowest ones.
requirements: Feed frame start times (in seconds) to a counter.
Report fps over the last second, the average and worst frame time.
Work out the "1% low": the fps of the slowest 1% of frames.
stretch: Draw a graph of frame times as text.
